categorymultisortneue: Label of the sidebar portlet that offers the sort modes. The message key is the portlet name, so the skin looks it up automatically and derives the portlet id (p-categorymultisortneue) and class (mw-portlet-categorymultisortneue) from it. Plural: this is the heading above a list of ways to sort the category.
categorymultisortneue-subtitle-label: Label before the sort mode links shown under a category page title. Do not add a colon: it is appended separately with the standard {{msg-mw|colon-separator}} message, because the colon and the space around it differ by language. The links are separated with {{msg-mw|comma-separator}}, not with a hard-coded character.
categorymultisortneue-link-aria:
Accessible label of one sort mode link in the portlet, so a screen reader announces the action rather than just the mode name. Parameters:
* $1 - the localised mode name
categorymultisortneue-mode-default: Dropdown entry for the sort mode whose collation is left empty in $wgCategoryMultisortNeueModes, i.e. the wiki's own $wgCategoryCollation.
categorymultisortneue-mode-pinyin: Example sort mode name. Wikis define their own modes; a mode id "foo" uses {{msg-mw|categorymultisortneue-mode-foo}} when it exists and falls back to the raw id "foo" when it does not.
categorymultisortneue-pref: Label of the user preference that stores the reader's preferred sort mode.
categorymultisortneue-pref-default: Preference option meaning "follow the wiki default sort mode".
categorymultisortneue-unavailable:
Error shown when a sort mode exists in configuration but its collation cannot be used. Parameters:
* $1 - the sort mode id
categorymultisortneue-magic-missing-mode:
Error of the {{msg-mw|multisortdefaultsort}} magic word when no sort mode was given. Parameters:
* $1 - comma separated list of known sort mode ids
categorymultisortneue-magic-unknown-mode:
Error of a CategoryMultisortNeue magic word when the given sort mode is not configured. Parameters:
* $1 - the sort mode that was given
* $2 - comma separated list of known sort mode ids
categorymultisortneue-magic-missing-arg:
Error of a CategoryMultisortNeue magic word when a required argument is empty. Parameters:
* $1 - name of the missing argument
categorymultisortneue-magic-invalid-cate:
Error of the {{msg-mw|multisortsortkey}} magic word when the second argument is not a category name. Parameters:
* $1 - the value that was given
categorymultisortneue-summary: Short explanation shown above the sort mode selector on a category page.
categorymultisortneue-unavailable-notice:
Notice shown on a category page when the requested sort mode could not be used and the wiki default order is shown instead. Parameters:
* $1 - the sort mode id that was requested
